newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: More than 30 Colombian police hurt in prison riot.
newsitem.headline: More than 30 Colombian police hurt in prison riot.

text.p: More than 30 Colombian policemen were injured on Saturday when a surprise search of a prison in the southwest city of Cali backfired on them, authorities said.

The NTC television news programme quoted police and prison officials as saying rebellious inmates inside Cali's Villa Hermosa jail attacked the search party with knives and other homemade weapons, injuring 32 officers.

A police spokeswoman in Cali told Reuters she was unable to provide an official casualty toll or explain how well-armed police were unable to better defend themselves. But she said at least four agents were seriously injured in the prison uprising.
"A lot of our companions were hurt," she said.
The search of the prison was prompted by word that inmates were planning to stage a mass breakout on Sunday, which is Colombia's national independence day.
